methodology: Five verse-level preliminary screenings of Qur'an 6:161-165. Qur'anic wording checked against Arabic and English presentation at almizan.org/chapter-6-al-anam/verses-161-165. Ezekiel 18:20 Hebrew and translation inspected at Sefaria; other locators remain leads. Source-specific parallels do not establish transmission. All entries private.
coverage_ledger_status: Draft checkpoint only; reconcile PR #230 and other open screening PRs into authoritative ledger; main is not assumed to contain them.

entries.summary: Abraham's upright religious way and repudiation of association

staged_candidates.comparison: Genesis depicts Abraham receiving a covenant and instruction to walk blamelessly; it does not formulate the Qur'anic hanif identity or explicitly describe the rejection of partners.

entries.caveat: Preliminary source comparison only. Exact critical edition, textual witnesses, chronology and translation provenance require validation before public display; no literary dependence inferred.

entries.summary: Prayer, sacrifice, life and death dedicated to God

staged_candidates.comparison: Exclusive devotion to the one God is shared; the biblical injunction to love God does not reproduce the Qur'anic prayer-sacrifice-life-death sequence.

entries.caveat: Preliminary source comparison only. Exact critical edition, textual witnesses, chronology and translation provenance require validation before public display; no literary dependence inferred.

entries.summary: No divine partner; command to submit

staged_candidates.comparison: Exclusive worship is a broad theological comparison; the Qur'anic self-identification as first among those submitting is distinct.

entries.caveat: Preliminary source comparison only. Exact critical edition, textual witnesses, chronology and translation provenance require validation before public display; no literary dependence inferred.

entries.summary: Each soul bears its own deeds; no bearer carries another's burden

staged_candidates.comparison: Ezekiel explicitly denies that child and parent bear each other's guilt; the Qur'an generalizes the non-transfer of burdens to every bearer and connects it to final return and adjudication.

entries.caveat: Preliminary source comparison only. Exact critical edition, textual witnesses, chronology and translation provenance require validation before public display; no literary dependence inferred.

entries.summary: Successors on earth, differing ranks as divine test

staged_candidates.comparison: Genesis gives humanity dominion over living creatures; it does not explicitly teach the Qur'anic generational succession and differentiated ranks as a test.

entries.caveat: Preliminary source comparison only. Exact critical edition, textual witnesses, chronology and translation provenance require validation before public display; no literary dependence inferred.
